sentences.en: And the last thing that they saw
sentences.zh: 而他们看到的最后景象，

sentences.en: was basically just an error message,
sentences.zh: 基本上就只是一条错误信息，

sentences.en: a server disconnect message.
sentences.zh: 一条服务器断开连接的消息。

sentences.en: And then the world ended.
sentences.zh: 然后世界就毁灭了。

sentences.en: That was game over for a show I worked on
sentences.zh: 那正是我曾参与制作的一个节目的结局，

sentences.en: called Snap Judgment,
sentences.zh: 名叫《速断抉择》，

sentences.en: which if you're not already a fan,
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是它的粉丝，

sentences.en: you should just go and trust me
sentences.zh: 你大可直接相信我，

sentences.en: and just download everything and listen to it.
sentences.zh: 把所有的节目都下载下来听听看。

sentences.en: You'll enjoy it.
sentences.zh: 你会喜欢的。

sentences.en: And it also was a collaboration with Robert Ashley,
sentences.zh: 这也算是与罗伯特·阿什利的合作，

sentences.en: who did the internet radio show
sentences.zh: 他制作了一个网络广播节目，

sentences.en: called A Life Well Wasted.
sentences.zh: 名叫《不枉此生》。

sentences.en: I heard that the bit of audio tape
sentences.zh: 我听过那段录音，

sentences.en: and the interview that he did
sentences.zh: 以及他关于这个故事所做的采访，

sentences.en: about this story on his podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 就在他的播客里。

sentences.en: And I asked him about it
sentences.zh: 我向他询问了这件事，

sentences.en: and we sort of, I interviewed him
sentences.zh: 我们算是……我采访了他，

sentences.en: and kind of rearranged the parts
sentences.zh: 然后重新编排了各个部分，

sentences.en: and took little bits of it
sentences.zh: 截取了其中的一些小片段，

sentences.en: and turned it into the piece that you heard.
sentences.zh: 把它做成了你刚才听到的作品。

sentences.en: So this is definitely a collaboration
sentences.zh: 所以这绝对是一次

sentences.en: with Robert Ashley.
sentences.zh: 与罗伯特·阿什利的合作。

sentences.en: The last episode of his show,
sentences.zh: 他节目的最后一集，

sentences.en: episode number six of A Life Well Wasted,
sentences.zh: 也就是《不枉此生》的第六集，

sentences.en: is a work of art.
sentences.zh: 简直是一件艺术品。

sentences.en: It's just beautiful.
sentences.zh: 实在是太美妙了。

sentences.en: So go look that up,
sentences.zh: 所以快去搜一下，

sentences.en: A Life Well Wasted,
sentences.zh: 《不枉此生》，

sentences.en: and download it.
sentences.zh: 然后把它下载下来。

sentences.en: That's the piece for this week.
sentences.zh: 这就是本周的内容。

sentences.en: I have another one coming,
sentences.zh: 我还有一期节目要推出，

sentences.en: I think next week or in two weeks
sentences.zh: 我想是在下周或者两周内，

sentences.en: before the new shows start on February 4th.
sentences.zh: 也就是2月4日新节目开播之前。

sentences.en: And really, any ideas you have,
sentences.zh: 说真的，你们有什么想法，

sentences.en: design stories, anything,
sentences.zh: 设计故事，或者别的什么，

sentences.en: pitch me something,
sentences.zh: 尽管向我投稿吧，

sentences.en: I respond really well to pitches.
sentences.zh: 我对各种提案的反应极好。

sentences.en: So let me know what you're thinking about
sentences.zh: 所以请让我知道你们的想法，

sentences.en: and what type of stories
sentences.zh: 以及你们希望在

sentences.en: you'd like to hear on 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 《99%隐形》里听到什么类型的故事。

sentences.en: Go to 99% Invisible.org.
sentences.zh: 请访问 99percentinvisible.org。

sentences.en: And thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家。
